QuestInfo.name: Fire Raccoon Finance Auditor
QuestInfo.0: Despite having obtained the secret ledger, order has yet to be restored to Showa town. Speak with #p9120014# again.
QuestInfo.1: #p9120014# is unwilling to use the ledger as evidence, as it reveals some of his colleagues are complicit to corruption. Instead, he has tasked you with finding a map depicting the location of a safe filled with treasure. It seems #o9400110#, #o9400102#, and #o9400103# occasionally carry fragments of the map. Work hard to collect enough fragments to assemble the map.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered all 3 map fragments and brought them to #p9120014#. As thanks for your efforts, you received the title Fire Raccoon Finance Auditor!

0.0: After all your hard work, I'm afraid I can't use the secret ledger as evidence... It contains the names of several of my colleagues.
0.1: There must be another way. Could you please help me one more time?

yes.0: Great. I need you to find three fragments of a map. I've heard that #o9400110#s, #o9400102#s, \nand #o9400103#s each have each been entrusted with a piece.\r\n
yes.1: With that map, I'll be able to take down Fire Raccoon Finance once and for all!!\r\n

no.0: Is this the end of Showa Town?

1.0: This is the map! You continue to amaze.

yes.0: You are the strongest, most diligent investigator I've ever had the pleasure of working with.
yes.1: In acknowledgement of all your efforts, I hereby declare you the Fire Raccoon Finance Auditor! Please continue to work hard to restore order to Showa town.

item.0: You don't have the map yet...
